enchantment.simpleriding.tailwind.desc: Increases ridden mount speed. Server defaults per level: horses 30%, other mounts and nautiluses 20%, Happy Ghasts 85%; level III maximum.
enchantment.simpleriding.leaping.desc: Increases ridden horse jump strength or nautilus dash strength. Server default: +20% per level; level III maximum.

simpleriding.guide.page.1.title: Simple Riding
simpleriding.guide.page.1: Saddle speed, horse jumps, nautilus dashes, mount armor utilities, loot and trades.
simpleriding.guide.page.2.title: Tailwind
simpleriding.guide.page.2: Tailwind I–III enhances saddles and all 16 colored harnesses. Apply a book at an anvil.
simpleriding.guide.page.3.title: Leaping
simpleriding.guide.page.3: Leaping I–III increases the jump strength of a player-controlled horse by 20% per level by default.
simpleriding.guide.page.4.title: Horse Armor Utilities
simpleriding.guide.page.4: Horse armor accepts Protection, Fire Protection, Blast Protection, Projectile Protection, Feather Falling, and Leaping.
simpleriding.guide.page.5.title: Horse Armor Utilities
simpleriding.guide.page.5: Other enchantments, including Mending and Unbreaking, are rejected by the source mod’s final whitelist.
simpleriding.guide.page.6.title: Exploration Loot
simpleriding.guide.page.6: Bastion treasure and other chests: 0–2 rolls; Tailwind II/III weights 20/10, Leaping II/III 10/5, empty 30.
simpleriding.guide.page.7.title: Librarian Trades
simpleriding.guide.page.7: Librarians at level 2 offer Tailwind I or Leaping I (weights 30/20), cost 10–29 emeralds, 2 uses, 25 XP, reputation discount 0.5.
simpleriding.guide.page.8.title: Registry and Sources
simpleriding.guide.page.8: The mod keeps simpleriding:tailwind, simpleriding:leaping, the riding_items creative tab, and the unused persistent coordinates BlockPos component for old saved stacks.
simpleriding.guide.page.9.title: Server Riding Bounds
simpleriding.guide.page.9: Client movement and jump commands are checked on the server thread.
simpleriding.guide.page.10.title: Horseshoes
simpleriding.guide.page.10: Horses, donkeys, mules, skeleton and zombie horses get four hoof slots in their inventory. Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite and (with SimpleBuilding) Enderite horseshoes improve handling and terrain;
simpleriding.guide.page.11.title: Horseshoes
simpleriding.guide.page.11: a full set adds a little speed and jump and slightly more fall damage.
simpleriding.guide.page.12.title: Settings
simpleriding.guide.page.12: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
